verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. Every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. The only related item is a general 'Discover Salesforce APIs' marketing line, which mentions APIs but not a spec. The CLI and MCP server are separate capabilities and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
